# case: 33-zellij-fresh-start
# desc: --zellij starts a fresh named Zellij session
# config: docker-darwin
--- exit ---
0
--- runtime-args ---
== docker run ==
--rm
-it
--memory
8g
--name
aic-project-<TIME>
-e
HOST_HOME=<HOME>
-e
HOST_UID=<UID>
-e
HOST_GID=<GID>
-w
<PROJ>
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude-contained/claude,dst=<HOME>/.claude
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.codex,dst=<HOME>/.codex
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.copilot,dst=<HOME>/.copilot
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.gemini,dst=<HOME>/.gemini
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.vibe,dst=<HOME>/.vibe
--mount
type=bind,src=<PROJ>,dst=<PROJ>
-e
TZ=UTC
-e
CLAUDE_CONTAINED_EXPLICIT_ENV_KEYS=TZ
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude/skills,dst=<HOME>/.claude/skills
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude/agents,dst=<HOME>/.claude/agents
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude/commands,dst=<HOME>/.claude/commands
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude/plugins,dst=<HOME>/.claude/plugins
-e
GIT_PROTECT_DIRS=<PROJ>
-e
CLAUDE_CONTAINED_ZELLIJ=1
-e
CLAUDE_CONTAINED_ZELLIJ_SESSION=cc-project-<PHASH>
--label
claude-contained.zellij=1
--label
claude-contained.zellij.session=cc-project-<PHASH>
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude-contained,dst=<HOME>/.claude-contained
claude-contained:latest
bash
-lc
if ! command -v "$0" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
       echo "error: claude-contained image is missing Zellij support (zellij-run)." >&2
       echo "       Rebuild it with: claude-contained --rebuild=full" >&2
       exit 127
     fi
     exec "$0" "$@"
zellij-run
cc-project-<PHASH>
--
bash
